the binding and fusion of liposomes to synaptosomal membranes is a complex process that is influenced by the surface charge of the liposomes and by the membrane fluidity of both liposomes and synaptosomes.
the extent and nature of liposome adsorptions onto synaptosomes depend on the charge and fluidity of liposomes.

In summary, our research is concerned with
the interaction of liposome surfaces with biological membranes.
understanding the mechanisms of interaction between liposomes and biological membranes.
the development of new methods for the preparation of liposomes, and with the interaction of these liposomes with biological membranes, with special emphasis on the brain.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the interaction of lipids with biological membranes is determined by the physicochemical properties of the lipids, the fluidity of the lipid bilayer, and the surface charge.
liposomes interact with biological membranes by a combination of adsorption and fusion, depending on liposome surface charge.

the interaction of liposome membranes with synaptosomal membrane is determined by the following factors: (1) the fluid state of the liposome, (2) the charge of the liposome membrane, (3) the charge of synaptosomal membrane, and (4) the temperature of the interaction.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the interaction of negatively charged liposomes (egg-phosphatiylcholine/phosphatidic acid) with biological membranes is a saturable phenomenon.
the interaction of liposome surface and synaptosomal membranes is determined by both liposome surface properties and membrane fluidity.
the interaction of liposome with biological membranes depends on the physical properties of the lipid bilayers of the liposome, and on the charge of the liposome surface.
The main takeaway from our work is that

liposome surface charge is the main factor in determining the interaction with biological membranes, and that liposome surface charges should be taken into consideration when designing liposomes for drug delivery.
the adsorption of liposomes to synaptosomes is not simply a function of surface charge, but that the fluidity and charge of the membrane are also important factors.
liposomes can be used to probe the structure and function of biological membranes.
